cohort: The study included women six weeks post-emergency caesarean section (average age 27.95 years) and health workers as key informants.
finding: Following emergency caesarean section, women reported a mix of positive experiences (e.g., successful surgery) and negative experiences (e.g., poor pain control, fear), alongside various support needs including financial aid and better communication.
mod_finding: The study specifically explored women's subjective experiences and support requirements following an emergency caesarean section, detailing both the challenges and aspects of care related to this mode of birth.
